business_problem: Revolut wanted to replace separate, feature-engineered models for fraud, credit, engagement, and recommendations with one reusable intelligence layer that could learn from long-range transaction histories without months of repeated ETL and validation work.
solution_summary: Revolut rebuilt its decisioning stack around PRAGMA, an encoder-style transaction foundation model trained on NVIDIA H100 GPU clusters in Nebius AI Cloud. Instead of maintaining isolated pipelines for fraud scoring, credit risk, marketing response, and lifetime-value prediction, the company pretrains one model across roughly 26 million user records spanning 111 countries and tens of billions of events. Merchant descriptions and other unstructured text are embedded into the same behavioral representation, so downstream teams can either attach lightweight heads for rapid experiments or apply LoRA fine-tuning for specialized tasks. The H100-based training setup uses sequence packing and dynamic batching to make large-scale pretraining feasible inside fixed windows, giving Revolut a single backbone for risk and growth use cases.

solution_components.name: PRAGMA
solution_components.role: Acts as the shared transaction foundation model that produces reusable behavioral embeddings across risk and growth use cases.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA H100 GPUs
solution_components.role: Provide the accelerated training infrastructure that makes large-scale pretraining and fine-tuning practical within Revolut's time windows.

solution_components.name: Nebius AI Cloud
solution_components.role: Hosts the H100 GPU clusters that Revolut uses for pretraining and experimentation at scale.

data_flow: Customer transaction histories and unstructured merchant descriptions are encoded into PRAGMA during large-scale pretraining on H100 clusters in Nebius AI Cloud. The resulting embeddings are reused by downstream heads or LoRA-tuned models for fraud detection, credit risk, and recommendation workflows, replacing separate ETL-heavy task pipelines.
integration_points: Merchant descriptions and other unstructured text
Fraud, credit, and recommendation decision systems
business_outcome: Revolut accelerated model-development cycles by 3-5x, raised training throughput by 2-5x, improved credit default identification accuracy by 2.3x, caught 65 percent more fraud while also improving fraud precision by 17 percent, and delivered 41 percent more relevant product recommendations.
